units.title: Kiahk Madih On Watos Psali

arabic: + أَمْدَحُ فِي عَذْرَاءَ وَبَتُولٍ: وَأَصِيحُ عَشِيَّةً مَعَ بُكْرَةٍ: بِأَعْلَى صَوْتِي وَأَقُولُ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ بِحَقٍّ إِنَّنَا نُعْطَى وَنَنَالُ: تِلْكَ الْخَيْرَاتِ الْمُنْتَظَرَةَ: إِذَا صِحْنَا بِالصَّوْتِ الْعَالِي: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ تَقَدَّمَ نَحْوَكِ غَبْرِيَالُ: وَأَعْلَنَ صَوْتَهُ بِالْبُشْرَى: وَأَعْطَاكِ السَّلَامَ وَقَالَ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ جَوْفُ أَحْشَاكِ حَمَلَ بَارِيكِ: كَمَا قَالَ أَهْلُ الْخِبْرَةِ: إِنَّ الرَّبَّ الْإِلَهَ يَسْكُنُ فِيكِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ حُلْوٌ هُوَ اسْمُكِ وَعَظِيمٌ: وَتَتَحَيَّرُ فِيهِ الْفِكْرَةُ: وَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ إِلَيْهِ حَكِيمٌ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ خَرَجَ آدَمُ خَارِجَ الْفِرْدَوْسِ: وَصَارَ كَئِيبًا فِي حَسْرَةٍ: وَأَعَادَهُ الرَّبُّ الْقُدُّوسُ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ عُمْرِي جَمِيعُهُ وَأَنَا سَكْرَانُ: شَارِبٌ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْخَمْرَةِ: وَمَادِحٌ فِي أُمِّ الدَّيَّانِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ رَتَّلَ فِيكِ الْفَاخُورِيُّ: وَسَمَّاكِ زَهْرَةً عَطِرَةً: وَأَخْبَرَ عَنْكِ الْمَزْمُورُ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ ذَلَّ آدَمُ وَبَقِيَ مَأْسُورًا: وَرَجَعَ بِابْنِكِ ثَانِيَ مَرَّةٍ: إِلَى رُتْبَتِهِ فَرِحًا مَسْرُورًا: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ سَبَقَ وَتَنَبَّأَ حِزْقِيَالُ: وَقَالَ يَأْتِي ذُو الْقُدْرَةِ: وَيَظْهَرُ مِنْكِ فِي عَقِبِ الْأَجْيَالِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ شَهِدَ مِيخَا قَالَ الْجَبَّارُ: يَأْتِي وَتَكُونُ النُّصْرَةُ: وَيَقُومُ اَللهُ عَلَى الْأَشْرَارِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ صَرَخَ دَاوُدُ بِصَوْتٍ حَنُونٍ: وَحَرَّكَ أَوْتَارَهُ الْعَشَرَةَ: أَحَبَّ الرَّبُّ أَبْوَابَ صِهْيَوْنَ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ ضَلَّ إِبْلِيسُ آدَمَ وَأَغْوَاهُ: وَأَكَلَ مِنْ تِلْكَ الشَّجَرَةِ: وَأَتَى ابْنُ اَللهِ وَفَدَاهُ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ طَأْطَأَ الرَّبُّ سَمَاءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ: وَجَاءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْقَفْرَةِ: وَتَشَبَّهَ هُوَ بِالْمَخْلُوقَاتِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ ظَهَرَ مِنْ بَيْتِ دَاوُدَ الْبَارِّ: وَشَفَانَا مِنْ كُلِّ مَضَرَّةٍ: وَعَرَّفَنَا سِرَّ الْأَسْرَارِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ عَيِيتُ وَأَنَا أَطْلُبُ تَفْسِيرًا: وَلَمْ أَبْلُغْ شَيْئًا بِكَثْرَةٍ: سِوَى تَمْجِيدٍ وَمَدِيحٍ يَسِيرٍ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ غَيْرُ الْمَرْئِيِّ كَيْفَ رَأَوْهُ: خَالِقُ مَا يُرَى وَمَا لَا يُرَى: كَيْفَ أَهْلُ الْعَالَمِ صَلَبُوهُ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ فَعَلُوا الشَّرَّ وَمَسَكُوا الْبَارَّ: وَصَلَبُوهُ الْقَوْمُ الْكَفَرَةُ: وَصَارَ لَهُمُ الْخِزْيُ مَعَ الْعَارِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ قَالَ إِنِّي وَاضِعٌ فِي صِهْيَوْنَ: صَخْرَةَ شَكٍّ وَحَجَرَ عَثْرَةٍ: عَثَرُوا فِيهِ وَقَدْ سَقَطُوا: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ كُنَّا فِي رِقِّ الْمَكَّارِ: تَحْتَ عُبُودِيَّةٍ مُرَّةٍ: وَابْنُكِ صَيَّرَنَا الْأَحْرَارَ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ لَبِسْتِ حُلَّةً مِنَ الْأَنْوَارِ: صِرْتِ يَا مَرْيَمُ شَجَرَةً: عَظِيمَةً حَامِلَةَ الْأَثْمَارِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ مُوسَى رَآكِ فَوْقَ جَبَلِ الطُّورِ: شِبْهَ الْعُلَّيْقَةِ الْخَضِرَةِ: مُشْتَمِلَةً بِشُعَاعِ النُّورِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ نُفِينَا وَعَدِمْنَا كُلَّ الْخَيْرَاتِ: وَرَجَعْنَا بِابْنِكِ ثَانِيَ مَرَّةٍ: إِلَى الْفِرْدَوْسِ أَرْضِ الْمِيعَادِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ هَزَمَ ابْنُكِ حِيَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ: وَصَارَ لَهُ الْغَلَبَةُ وَالنُّصْرَةُ: وَقَدْ فَرِحَ أَهْلُ الْإِيمَانِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ وَجَدْتُ نِعْمَةً وَقَدْ نِلْتُ: فَرَحًا مَعَ بَهْجَةٍ وَمَسَرَّةٍ: وَوَصْفُكِ يَعْلُو عَلَى مَقْدِرَتِي: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ لِأَنَّهُ ظَهَرَ مِنْكِ يَنْبُوعٌ: حُلْوٌ أَيَّتُهَا الصَّخْرَةُ: اِسْأَلِي فِينَا ابْنَكِ الرَّبَّ يَسُوعَ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ يَا أُمَّ النُّورِ كَمْ أَجِيرٍ: جَاءَ فِي الْآخِرِ وَأَخَذَ الْأُجْرَةَ: وَأَنَا الْمِسْكِينُ أَتَيْتُ الْأَخِيرَ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
+ اَلسَّلَامُ لِمَرْيَمَ وَالْغِبْطَاتُ: وَأَنَا وَجَمِيعُ مَنْ فِي هَذِهِ الْبِيعَةِ: نَصِيحُ وَنَقُولُ بِأَعْلَى الْأَصْوَاتِ: طُوبَاكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَذْرَاءُ
english: + I praise the Virgin and the Maiden: and I cry out in the evening and the morning: with my highest voice I say: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ In truth we are given and we receive: those awaited blessings: when we cry out with a loud voice: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Gabriel came towards you: and announced his voice with the good news: and gave you the peace and said: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ The womb of your bosom carried your Creator: as the people of experience said: that the Lord God dwells in you: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Sweet is your name and great: and the mind is bewildered by it: and no wise man has reached it: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Adam went out of Paradise: and became sorrowful in regret: and the Holy Lord restored him: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ My whole life I am intoxicated: drinking from that wine: and praising the Mother of the Judge: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ The Fakhouri chanted about you: and called you a fragrant flower: and the Psalm told about you: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Adam was humbled and remained captive: and returned by your Son a second time: to his rank joyful and happy: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Ezekiel previously prophesied: and said the One of Power shall come: and shall appear from you in the succession of generations: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Micah testified and said the Mighty One: shall come and the victory shall be: and God shall rise against the wicked: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ David cried out with a tender voice: and moved his ten strings: The Lord loved the gates of Zion: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Iblis misled Adam and seduced him: and he ate from that tree: and the Son of God came and redeemed him: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ The Lord bowed the heaven of heavens: and came to the barren earth: and He became like the creatures: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ He appeared from the house of righteous David: and healed us from every harm: and made us know the mystery of mysteries: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ I am weary while seeking an interpretation: and I have not reached anything in abundance: except for glorification and a little praise: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ The Invisible One how did they see Him: Creator of what is seen and what is not seen: how did the people of the world crucify Him: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ They did evil and seized the Righteous One: and the infidel people crucified Him: and shame and disgrace became theirs: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ He said I am placing in Zion: a rock of doubt and a stone of stumbling: they stumbled in Him and they fell: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ We were in the slavery of the deceiver: under bitter bondage: and your Son made us the free: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ You wore a robe of lights: you became O Mary a tree: great and bearing fruits: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Moses saw you upon Mount Sinai: like the green bush: covered with the ray of light: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ We were exiled and lacked all blessings: and we returned by your Son a second time: to Paradise the land of promise: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Your Son defeated the tricks of Satan: and the victory and triumph became His: and the people of faith rejoiced: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ I found grace and I have attained: joy with delight and pleasure: and your description rises above my ability: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Because a fountain appeared from you: sweet O you the Rock: ask your Son the Lord Jesus for us: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ O Mother of the Light how many a laborer: came in the end and took the wage: and I the poor one came last: Blessed are you O Virgin
+ Peace to Mary and the blessings: and I and all who are in this church: cry out and say with the highest voices: Blessed are you O Virgin

units.sourceTitle: أمدح في عذراء وبتول (مديح كيهكي علي الإبصالية واطس)
